    assert get_positive([-1, 2, -4, 5, 6]) == [2, 5, 6]

    assert get_positive([-3.5, 3.5, 2, -2]) == [3.5, 2]
    # Single element
    assert get_positive([7]) == [7]
    assert get_positive([-7]) == []
